title: target/v1
description: targets/<id>/target.yaml (F11-R1; D-6, D-10): the curator's intake record for one target — D-6's five artifacts (prior art, library coverage, provenance, attack routes, a root witness, the last of which is a file rather than a field), where the statement came from and under what licence, and the D-10 posting that makes the target claimable. The derived values are NOT here: a target's fidelity grade comes from its certificates (F11-R3) and its claimability from status, grade and posting (F11-R4); both are published in targets/index.json. Absent, a target behaves as it did before F11 (F03-Q4, Q5). Versioned, never edited (D-34).

informal.description: The informal statement as the source states it. Null when the source states no licence: reproducing it would be republishing it (F11-R10), and `paraphrase` stands in its place.

paraphrase.description: The network's own one-line paraphrase. Required by intake when `informal` is null (F11-R10).

track.description: D-6: `open` is a genuinely open problem; `formalization` is the second-class track a known result sits on.

curator.description: The curator's identity. D-21: they earn no proof credit on this target.

prior_art.description: D-6 artifact 1. Free text, untrusted downstream (F11 §7).

library_coverage.description: D-6 artifact 2: what the pinned Mathlib already has, and what it does not.

provenance.description: D-6 artifact 3, D-10: who wrote the statement this target formalizes, and whether it was adversarially reviewed.

sources.description: Every external source this target copies from or cites, with its licence. `none-stated` is a real answer and gates what the site may reproduce (F11-R10).

licence.description: An SPDX identifier, or `none-stated` where the source publishes no licence.

attack_routes.description: D-6 artifact 4, advisory: routes worth trying, or the ones already spent. May be empty (F11-R2).

posting.description: D-10: where this target was posted upstream. Null until `intake post` records one; claimability needs it (F11-R4).

domains.description: Domain tags. D-6 excludes four of them from Stage 0 intake; F11-R2 refuses on any of them.

qa_summary.description: One paragraph on the D-9 v3.12 statement-QA pass, for the Targets page (F11-R10, R13). The pass itself is recorded as evidence in the network repo at Stage 0; F12 tools it.
